subject: DONE s385b (4d0a38f): ONE `heredoc_is_raw` predicate — `<< 'E'` / `<<~'E'` stopped interpolating
description:
Found s385 while diagnosing #299 (closure.t RT #23265, an assertion that only runs once #291's enabler lands). PRE-EXISTING on plain main — probed at e3616eb with no instrumentation.

REPRODUCER (perl keeps the text raw; PCL interpolates it away):
  my $x = "XX"; my @y = ("A","B");
  my $b = << 'E2';
  raw $x @y \n
  E2
  print $b;
  # perl: raw $x @y \n
  # PCL : raw   <newline>          <-- $x and @y GONE, \n became a real newline

MEASURED, all four spellings (scratchpad hd3.pl):
  <<'E'     raw   raw    OK
  << 'E'    raw   INTERPOLATED   BUG
  <<~'E'    raw   INTERPOLATED   BUG
  <<~ 'E'   raw   INTERPOLATED   BUG
  <<"E" / << "E" / <<~"E"  all interpolate in both — OK

CAUSE, one line: `Pl/PExpr.pm:750`
    if ($marker !~ /^<<'/) { ...route through parse_interpolated_string... }
The test demands the quote IMMEDIATELY after `<<`. Perl allows optional
whitespace before a QUOTED terminator, and `<<~` puts a `~` there. PPI
tokenises all of them correctly (probed: content=`<< 'E2'`, terminator=`E2`),
so this is purely PCL's classification.

FOUR COPIES of the same predicate exist (grep `\^<<`):
  Pl/PExpr.pm:750        /^<<'/     <-- misses `~` AND whitespace (the one that decides interpolation)
  Pl/Parser2.pm:2047     /^<<~?'/   <-- misses whitespace   (_interp_canon)
  Pl/Parser2.pm:3255     /^<<~?'/   <-- misses whitespace   (_fix_interp_token)
  Pl/Parser2.pm:4875     /^<<~?'/   <-- misses whitespace   (_interp_names)

FIX (CLAUDE.md rule 11 — one shared predicate, not four regexes): add
`heredoc_is_raw($token)` to Pl/PExpr/TokenUtils.pm reading
`($t->{_heredoc_content} // $t->content) =~ /^<<~?\s*'/` and route all four
sites through it. The `_heredoc_content` override must stay — the rename
passes rewrite it.

WHY IT WAS INVISIBLE: `<<~'EOF'` is the modern spelling and `<< 'EOF'` is rare
in the corpus; the one perl-tests assertion that catches it (closure.t
RT #23265) sits inside a top-level form that dies at load today (#205), so the
row never ran. Same class as the #138 silently deleted statement: source text
is mangled, no diagnostic.

GUARD: one transpile-test row covering all seven spellings against perl
(scratchpad hd3.pl is the ready-made body).</description>
